purpose: Record independently verified public Git-DAG evidence that legacy Neurosetta contained morphology geometry, subtree, root-coordinate, and scaling/alignment capabilities before the December 2025 Point_data artifact.

verified_capability_timeline.message: Added functions for Transforming and Scaling neurons
patch broken imports from previous push
observed_capabilities: pre-artifact transformation/scaling implementation remains present in the public history

verified_capability_timeline.message: Function to get the centre of mass from all neurons in a Forest

observed_capabilities: simplified-to-full-neuron vertex-index mapping fix for subtree identification

verified_capability_timeline.message: mainly load mesh file added and fixes to sub tree identification
observed_capabilities: subtree identification fixes remain in the latest public pre-artifact snapshot

observed_behavior: align_neuron centers coordinates on the mean
snap_to_axis aligns coordinate principal axes through eigen decomposition
coordinate_scale performs per-axis linear scaling and can invert factors
optimal_partition_root simplifies the neuron, scores candidate branch roots, and maps the winning simplified coordinate back to the full graph
g_subtree and g_subtree_mask materialize downstream subtree selections

strengthens: A substantial legacy software capability chain existed publicly before the December 2025 artifact.
Root-coordinate extraction, subtree identification, PCA/eigen-axis alignment, centering, and explicit scaling were all independently observable before the artifact boundary.
does_not_prove: The December 2025 Point_data.pkl was produced by any specific legacy commit.
The exact December 2025 local/private Neurosetta installation or revision.
That the public legacy functions were invoked with the parameters actually used to generate Point_data.pkl.
That the historical Point_data rows came from the currently public four project SWCs.

next_target: Recover an execution-level bridge: historical notebook/script, environment lock, local archive, or other artifact that binds Point_data.pkl to a concrete Neurosetta/GeoJax revision and input morphology materialization.
